connection.description: ws (default), webhook (httpHostToken POST), or wss (reverse WS via httpHostToken)

master.description: 框架 master（platform user id；AI/工具权限、endpoint 管理）。endpoints[i].master 可逐项覆盖

en.description: Framework masters (platform user id; AI/tool permissions and endpoint management). endpoints[i].master can override this value.

trusted.description: 框架 trusted 用户列表（弱于 master）。endpoints[i].trusted 可逐项追加

en.description: Framework trusted users, below master authority. endpoints[i].trusted can add users.

endpoints.description: 多账号：每项明确选择 platform/userId，id 为本地账号名称，其余连接字段覆盖实例默认值

master.description: 本 endpoint 的框架 master（platform user id）；覆盖顶层 master

en.description: Framework masters for this endpoint (platform user id), overriding the top-level master list.

trusted.description: 本 endpoint 的 trusted 列表

url.description: OneBot implementation WebSocket URL (required for connection: ws)

path.description: HTTP/WS path for webhook or reverse-wss

api_url.description: HTTP action endpoint for webhook outbound (required for connection: webhook send)

en.description: Each endpoint explicitly selects platform and userId. id is the local account name; other connection fields override instance defaults.

commandPrefix.description: 命令前缀（默认 '' 无前缀，任意文本按命令匹配；如 '/' 要求 / 开头）。endpoints[i] 可逐项覆盖

en.description: Command prefix. The default empty string allows unprefixed commands; '/' requires a leading slash. Each endpoints[i] can override it.
